heading: This project is in a private environment.
explanation: You are opening a work-in-progress version, shared only with people who were invited. That is why we ask for a confirmation before showing the content.

wip.title: It is work in progress
wip.help: The content may change, go offline for a few minutes or use test data.

guests.title: Access is for guests only
guests.help: Whoever looks after the project set a username and a password so it is not open to anybody on the internet.

private.title: Your password never reaches the project
private.help: Portta checks the access before opening the project. The application never receives your password.

formHint: Use the username and password you were given.
locked_one: Too many wrong attempts. For safety, try again in {{count}} minute.
locked_other: Too many wrong attempts. For safety, try again in {{count}} minutes.
noAccess: Did not get access? Ask the person or team who sent you this address.
unavailableHeading: This access is no longer available.
unavailableLead: The address you opened no longer has an active protection. If it was a temporary link, its agreed time may have ended.

expected.title: This may be expected
expected.help: Temporary links are created with a deadline, so access is not left open forever.

untouched.title: The project was not affected
untouched.help: Only this address stopped working. Nothing changed in the project.

comeBack.title: How to get back in
comeBack.help: Ask for a new link from the person or team who shared this address with you.

unavailableCard: This link's time may have ended, or the access was changed. Whoever sent it can create another in a few seconds.
unavailableHelp: Do not know who sent it? Look for the message where you got this address.
